scientific_integrity: Complete finite enumeration, direct acyclic matching and integer Morse differential with reproducible standard-library checkers; no inference from sparse samples or unperformed external audit.
scientific_limitations: An exact result for only C_7 x K_3 and C_8 x K_3; no all-parameter torsion-free theorem, canonical suspension map, or general equivariant assertion. The 2023 source already observes nonzero free homology in both allowed degrees but not complete integral homotopy types.
title: Two minimal three-color cycle products have suspension-related integral homotopy types
